{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) |versus_send_cost = {{Money|210}} |versus_wave_unlock = 15 |versus_eco = {{Money|15}} |versus_number = 2-3 |versus_timer = 1 }} ==Description== The '''Hazmat''' is an enemy that appears in [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Challenge Trials]], Basic Arena [[PVP]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. It can also be sent by a player in Basic Arena [[PVP]], which is the only way for it to appear there. It has a decent amount of health, a slightly fast speed and 60% defense. Additionally, it always spawns with the [[Stun Immunity|Stun]] and [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze Immunity]], making it harder to slow down. On multiple waves, it also appears with the [[Health Regen]] and [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attributes. It can be spawned by the [[Grave Digger]] with its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability. [[Patient Zero]] also used to be able to summon it. Due to a bug, it used to replace the [[Hazardous]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Hazmat''' has a dark green skin color. It wears a yellow and black hazmat suit, which consists of single glove, a vest, gas tank, shoes and a helmet with a broken screen. It has three different walking animations that are randomly chosen when it spawns. |Version 1 |The '''Hazmat''' had a light green skin color, as well as a black torso, arms and legs. It worea yellow and black hazmat suit, which consists of shoulder-pads, a vest, gas tanks, shoes and a helmet with a translucent grey screen. It had three different walking animations that were randomly chosen when it spawns. }} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] can be quite useful against this. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Pyromancer]] can be quite useful against this, as it spawns in groups. **Additionally, splash damage towers bypass its [[Defense]], allowing them to deal full damage to it and making them especially useful against the '''Hazmat'''. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[DJ Booth]] can be useful against this, as it has quite high defense. **Additionally, the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Jester]] can be quite efficient at killing '''Hazmats'''. **As it has [[Freeze Immunity]], freezing towers cannot be used to drop its defense. **It cannot be knocked back as it has the [[Stun Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} HazmatIntermediate.png|First version,
